title: Outrider's Stellar Attunement
description: Solarian Stellar Attunement helper for Starfinder 2e: cycles Unattuned → Graviton ⇄ Photon → Unattuned, and swaps token art to match whenever attunement changes (macro, Token HUD, or character sheet). Optional JB2A token borders and Solar Weapon / Solar Flare attack animations via Sequencer, an animation picker with preview, Dynamic Token Ring colors, and per-player effect choices.

recommends.reason: Token borders, attack animations and the animation picker
Token border and attack animations (the free JB2A_DnD5e also works, with fewer variants)
